Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Chandra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vivek Chandra, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Manish Kumar Pandey,
learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.
2. By means of the instant application the applicant seeks bail in F.I.R. No.731 of 2022, under sections 420,409,504,506, I.P.C., P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a First Information Report lodged on 23.07.2022 against 6 named persons, including the applicant, alleging that the informant used to work as an Agent in M/s Lifelong Care Multi State Agro Cooperative Society Ltd. and he had invested some amount of his own and had got huge sums of money invested by other persons aggregating to Rs. 50,78,961/-.
4.

1 innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

sentences.text: In para 14 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application the applicant's involvement in 43 other cases has been shown, all of which relate to the allegations of non-refund of amount invested in the aforesaid company, in 33 of which he has been granted bail.

The Learned counsel for the applicant states that one of the co-accused Abhishek Upadhyay, who is said to be the Branch Head of the Company's Branch Office, has been granted bail by this Court by means of an order dated 29.05.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 2446 of 2023.

sentences.text: The co-accused Ajeet Kumar, who used to work as an agent in the Cooperative Society has also been enlarged on bail by this court by means of an order dated 02.08.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9728 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9728 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: A co-accused Atul Kumar Verma has also been granted bail in the present case by this court by means of an order dated 12.10.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.12173 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.12173 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has been implicated in the present case because he is one of the Directors of the Company and that seven co-accused persons who are said to be working in the company, have already been granted bail, whereas the applicant is in jail since 07.07.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
